rule_or_pattern: Drop lines containing an optical-rotation prefix before a Greek chemical name: (?:^|[\s,(])(?:[0-9]|[IΙldὰ])\s?-\s?[\u0370-\u03FF\u1F00-\u1FFF] (the printed small italic d-/l- is read as 1-, 4-, I-, Ι-), and lines with a molecular formula like C\d+H\d+ (subscripts flattened).
notes: The polytonic prose, the botanical Latin names, and the German/French/English oil names read correctly (1-20, 25-27, 33-35, 37, 38, 40), so the language flags come from genre. The faults are in the 'Συστατικά:' constituent lists. The small italic 'd-'/'l-' before terpenes is read as '1-' (21, 24), 'Ι-' (22), '4-' (39), and a stray 'd' becomes 'ὰ' (23). The formula C10H18 in 23 also loses its subscripts. This affects only a few percent of the book's lines.
